name: Tally test 1
request:
Write exactly 1 email announcing the launch of this product to people who have not bought it yet - make the case for why it matters now and what to do next.

Tone of voice: Friendly and casual - warm and conversational, like a text from someone the reader trusts.
audience_segment: The ops or no-code person on a small team whose intake form is step one of an automation nobody owns
